correctness.rationale: For area-one regular k-gons, rho_k=(k tan(pi/k))^-1/2 rises with k, R_k=rho_k sec(pi/k) falls, and k rho_k rises. On overlap (rho_m,R_m) h(t)=n acos(rho_n/t)-m acos(rho_m/t) decreases strictly from positive to negative, giving exactly one density crossing. Outside overlap density differences retain the stated signs. Thus F_m-F_n increases then decreases, strictly positive on (rho_n,R_n), TV equals Kolmogorov at the crossing, W1 is mean-radius difference. The radial-sector integration yields an elementary M(k) with sec/tan/log. Independently numerically checked six widely separated pairs including (4,6) t=.567729021647736, TV=.053443541641648. Finite checks corroborate the all-pairs analytic proof.
